body:
The initial native session observation UI is demonstrated for a live first Codex turn and deterministic streaming/reconnect fixtures. Remaining adapter work from #130:

- Enable and demonstrate exact raw response events on resumed/forked Codex turns. The adapter starts a fresh app-server process per turn; the current opt-in is on thread/start. Do not infer response completion from token-usage notifications.
- Correct tool-to-model-response attribution when tool activity arrives after rawResponse/completed. Content currently renders, but can appear in the following displayed step.
- Run the Claude adapter through the production browser with a cheap model; adapter and SDK tests alone do not demonstrate the live path.

Acceptance: use the production handler and inspect the actual native events and rendered tool/final content for these paths. Reuse the existing browser proof rather than building another validation framework.

comments.body:
PR #202 is merged as dd1f699. It fixes delayed and sequential tool attribution using native raw call/output pairs. Live production-handler validation on Codex gpt-5.6-luna demonstrated raw completion followed by tool A start/finish and tool B start/finish, all in the same response row, with the final answer in a separate response. Claude Haiku tool/final rendering also passed. Claude Opus 5 reviewed the final change: https://github.com/tylergannon/gimble/pull/202#issuecomment-5670333233

This issue stays open for exact raw events on native fork and resume after daemon restart or thread unload. Installed codex-cli 0.153.4 exposes experimentalRawEvents only on thread/start; thread/fork and thread/resume ignore the field. A socket-only reconnect should preserve the loaded thread flag according to source, but was not browser-attested. No response boundaries were inferred from token-usage updates, and no history-replay workaround was added.

The remaining gap also affects accounting: the demonstrated fork made a tool call and a final-answer call, but its single turn-finalized step retained only the first call usage. Treat those fork/post-restart accounting rows as incomplete until native raw-event support is available. Source and live evidence are linked in PR #202.

title: Complete native event adapter coverage for resumed turns and tool attribution
